title: UNIQON Billing Pro • Build 278 (Independent Desktop & Android Releases)
highlights: Swipe Navigation Across Mobile Tabs: Switch seamlessly between bottom navigation tabs (Home <-> Sales <-> Parties <-> Items <-> More) with left and right horizontal swipes.
Form Field Validation Highlights: Missing required fields (such as Customer Name in Invoices, Quotations, and Job Sheets) are highlighted with a soft red fill and prominent red border.
Calendar Real-Date Festival Engine: Test festival setup is permanently reset from normal views; 3D animation and music now only trigger on actual calendar festival dates and shop owner birthday.
Universal Business Edition: Fresh setups default to the Universal Business Edition for all retail and wholesale businesses with direct module unlock assistance (+91 8667237053).
Dedicated Platform Release Isolation: Windows updates independently from Android without cross-platform update conflicts.
fixes: Reset debug festival test banner from all desktop dashboards and topbars.
Added horizontal swipe gesture navigation across mobile views.
Added red outline validation and auto-focus for missing customer and job sheet fields.
Replaced mobile-accessories default with Universal Business Edition onboarding.
Maintained isolated update streams for Windows EXE and Android APK.
